defect: The fix only rewords the NotImplementedException message of Catalog::PlanMergeInto to name the database type and mention ON CONFLICT.
reason: An error-message wording change repairs no defect in the new file.

defect: The fix deletes AggregateState::Clear(), which was no longer called anywhere by the time of the fix.
reason: Removing a dead helper after Combine was reworked by later commits is cleanup, not a repair of a defect from this change.

defect: The new is_null flag leaves state->value unset for a NULL first value, yet Destroy still frees value's data when is_set and not inlined, so a NULL state deletes an uninitialized pointer.
reason: Before the change a NULL was stored as NullValue in value, so Destroy was safe; the fix adds the missing !is_null check to Destroy for exactly the state this change created.

defect: In ExecuteLoop the !RIGHT_CONSTANT branch asserts ASSERT_RESTRICT on ldata instead of rdata, a copy-paste slip that never checks the right input for aliasing and checks the wrong range when the left side is constant.
reason: The new file introduced the wrong pointer in the restrict assertion and the fix replaces ldata with rdata on that line.

defect: The fix adapts WindowSegmentValue to a later change of aggregate combine, whose input became a vector of state pointers instead of a flat state buffer.
reason: The combine call was correct for the API of the time; the breakage came from the later combine-interface change named in the fix message.

defect: The change adds a second #include of table_data_writer.hpp; the amalgamation script replaces every occurrence of an include statement with the header text the first time it is written, so the header body appears twice in duckdb.cpp and the amalgamation fails to compile.
reason: table_data_reader.cpp is the first file in amalgamation order to include that header, and the fix (adding an amalgamation CI job) removes exactly this duplicate include.

defect: The fix forwards a client_properties argument in the recursive UNION FromValue call after FromValue later gained that parameter.
reason: At the change FromValue took only (value, type); the missing argument stems from the later API change, not from this line.

defect: The fix threads ClientProperties through UnionConvert after the other converters gained that parameter in a later change.
reason: UnionConvert matched the converter signature of its time; the fix adapts it to a later interface change.

defect: The new ShouldRenderWhitespace loops with for (; x >= 0; x--) on unsigned idx_t, an always-true comparison that raises a warning which the warnings-as-errors build turns into a compile failure.
reason: The fix changes exactly this loop header to for (;; x--), and the commit message names the warning-turned-error.

defect: The typedef copy_from_get_chunk and the member copy_from_get_chunk share one name inside CopyFunction, which GCC rejects because the declaration changes the meaning of the name.
reason: The fix renames the typedef to copy_from_get_chunk_t to fix the GCC compile error caused by the lines this change added.

defect: The new SAMPLE_SIZE = -1 branch uses ULLONG_MAX without including <climits>, which fails to compile on Linux.
reason: The fix adds <limits> and replaces ULLONG_MAX with numeric_limits, repairing the Linux compile error from the added line.

defect: The fix restructures how the Patas scan state stores segment_data and initializes the group byte reader, in code rewritten by many intermediate commits (packed data, buffered scan).
reason: The fixed lines (group_state.Init, LoadPackedData) did not exist in this draft; they came from later commits.

defect: The change makes the early return for set columns effective (max_columns_found == set_columns.Size()), so a first accepted candidate blocks a later one even if that one has more consistent rows; the fix adds consistent_rows <= best_consistent_rows.
reason: The fixed condition is this change's line, but the losing scenario seems to need the later relaxation that accepts inconsistent rows with ignore_errors (72e73ca), and the test the fix enables does not set columns.

defect: Inside a function expression the new branch always clears the qualified column's alias, discarding a user-written alias (a named parameter such as struct_pack(a := col)) instead of only the alias that qualification added.
reason: The fix reorders the branches so a pre-existing alias is kept and only an empty one is cleared, repairing the logic this change introduced.

defect: ResolveDefaults now indexes column_index_map (and the default expressions) by the logical oid, while the same rework builds column_index_map in bind_insert.cpp over physical columns only, so tables with generated columns map the wrong source columns and defaults.
reason: The fix replaces oid with storage_idx in exactly these lines, matching how the binder builds the map.

defect: The fix makes clang-tidy style changes (empty() instead of size() == 0, inlining a temporary).
reason: A lint fix does not repair a functional defect.

defect: The module-level from_parquet overloads declare py::arg('union_by_name') without a default, making the new keyword required so existing calls such as duckdb.from_parquet(path) fail.
reason: The fix adds = false to exactly these two arguments, restoring the broken Python interface.

defect: OFFSET_SIZE_MINUS_ONE_SHIFT is 5, but the Parquet variant metadata header stores offset_size_minus_one in bits 6-7, so the offset size is decoded wrongly.
reason: The fix changes the constant introduced here from 5 to 6; seeing it requires the Variant specification.

defect: The fix corrects the typo 'seperator_option' in function descriptions.
reason: Documentation text only.

defect: The fix drops the to_string.hpp include while rewriting the top-N operator for a sanitizer issue.
reason: Removing an include that became unnecessary is cleanup; the sanitizer problem lies in other code.

defect: Moving right_sel into ReduceExecuteInfo reuses one selection buffer across iterations, but the right slice (and through the lambda result the next left slice) is a dictionary vector that shares that buffer, so the next iteration overwrites indices still in use.
reason: Before the change each iteration made a fresh selection vector; the fix makes right_sel local again 'to prevent referencing issues'.

defect: The fix rewrites the assertion to use columns.GetColumn(LogicalIndex(...)) after a merge from master changed TableCatalogEntry::columns to a ColumnList.
reason: At this change columns was a vector<ColumnDefinition> and the line compiled; the compile error came from the merge 8d7dd9b.

defect: The fix turns the static IsForeignKeyIndex into DataTable::IsForeignKeyIndex so the moved FindForeignKeyIndex in table_index.cpp can call it.
reason: The static helper was fine at the time; the need for it elsewhere was created by the later refactor 10286aa.

defect: The new TableIndex::FindForeignKeyIndex calls IsForeignKeyIndex, a static function defined only in data_table.cpp, so table_index.cpp does not compile outside a unity build.
reason: The fix includes data_table.hpp and calls the now-public DataTable::IsForeignKeyIndex, repairing the CI build break this file introduced.

defect: The fix removes the debug assertion that the bound column is STANDARD, which had become incorrect.
reason: This change only wrapped the existing assertion in #ifdef DEBUG; the assertion itself predates it.

defect: The fix reformats the memory-leak test file and drops a commented-out line.
reason: Test formatting only.

defect: VariantColumnStatsData::GetOrCreateElement/GetOrCreateField are members of an element of stats.columns but emplace_back into stats.columns and then write element_stats/field_stats through this, a use-after-free once the vector reallocates.
reason: The fix moves both methods to VariantStatsData taking a parent index, removing the dangling this; the bodies are in variant_stats.cpp.

defect: UnshreddedVariantValue returns NULL when input.RowIsValid(row) is true, the inverted condition, so every valid row is unshredded as NULL.
reason: The fix negates exactly this new check (if (!input.RowIsValid(row))).

defect: The fix reads skipped list values in chunks of STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE because Read into a single vector overflows when more than one vector of rows is skipped.
reason: At this change Skip was only called with result.size() (at most one vector); larger skips arrived with lazy skipping (73d65d1, ApplyPendingSkips), which broke the assumption.

defect: The fix removes the whole row_number() window path for non-delim joins in CreateDuplicateEliminatedJoin.
reason: This change only reformatted two lines of that block; the removed logic came from earlier commits.

defect: The fix makes InitializeChild copy the column name into owned storage instead of pointing child.name at a caller's temporary string.
reason: The dangling name.c_str() in InitializeChild predates this change, which only added AddName and the format ownership.

defect: The new file uses an angle-bracket #include <duckdb/planner/tableref/bound_cteref.hpp>, which the amalgamation script does not inline, so the amalgamated build cannot find the header.
reason: The fix replaces it with a quoted include (and drops unused includes), repairing the include this change added.

defect: The fix factors TransformNumberLiteral into ConvertNumberToValue so a minus prefix can be folded into the literal for the largest negative numbers.
reason: This change only reformatted the function; the negative-overflow problem lies in later prefix handling.

defect: The fix adds special handling of a single '-' prefix on a number literal in TransformPrefixExpression to avoid overflow for the most negative values.
reason: This change only corrected the child indices (which the fix keeps); the prefix loop the fix rewrites was added later.

defect: The fix destroys logical types the new tests leaked.
reason: The leak is in test code and the fix is a test change.

defect: The fix replaces column_definitions.size() == 0 with empty() for a linter.
reason: Style-only change.

defect: The fix makes force_external force repartitioning, adds a repartitioned flag for a single-collection shortcut, and turns a clear into an assertion so tests exercise the out-of-core path.
reason: The changed conditions are kept; the fix adds test-driven behaviour and repairs a shortcut added by later commits.

defect: The fix ('fix nits') replaces map<MetricsType,bool> operator_settings with a settings set and adds HasOperatorSetting.
reason: Review-nit refactor without a functional defect.

defect: The fix passes settings by const reference and switches operator_settings to a set with HasOperatorSetting.
reason: Review-nit refactor; behaviour is unchanged.

defect: The fix changes SetError/SetErrorMaybe to take const char* (with SetErrorFromString for strings) to avoid building std::string from NULL error messages.
reason: The NULL message comes from pre-existing callers such as CheckResult; the lines from this change are only adapted to the new SetError signature.
